description: This file defines a custom exception class `FineractEntityAccessConfigurationException` used for handling errors related to entity access configuration in the Fineract project. It extends an abstract domain rule exception and constructs an error message based on entity IDs, types, and access types.

classes.name: FineractEntityAccessConfigurationException
classes.description: Custom exception class for entity access configuration errors, extending `AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException` and providing detailed error messages.

methods.name: FineractEntityAccessConfigurationException
methods.description: Constructor that creates the exception with a detailed message including entity IDs, types, and access types.
